title: The registry-based half of REQ-102 (registering ig-account-create so the ClawRouter genesis loop can run_skill it) is mechanically broken as specified — the runtime never reads the registry's entrypoint field, and ig-account-create has no non-interactive entrypoint to point at
evidence: `grep -n '"ig-account-create"' ~/anicca/skills/registry.json` -> 0 matches (only `"earn/clip"` matches at line 124). The stated gap is real.

`~/anicca/runtime/loop/run-skill.mjs:105-112` (resolveSkillPath): `return path.join(home, 'skills', slot.replace('/', path.sep), 'run.sh');` — the filename 'run.sh' is HARDCODED, and the registry's own `entrypoint` field for the slot is never read anywhere in this function or file.

Repo-wide grep confirms `.entrypoint` is read in exactly ONE place: `~/anicca/install.sh:123` (`entry=$(jq -r --arg k "$slot" '.slots[$k].entrypoint' "$REGISTRY")`), used only to print a human-facing 'reserved, entrypoint $entry pending' message for slots with status!=live — NOT consumed by any code path that actually invokes a skill at runtime.

`~/.claude/skills/ig-account-create/scripts/` contains only cdp.py, cdp_incognito.py, ig_dob.py, read_otp.py, read_sms_otp.py, setup_profile.py, plus SKILL.md — no run.sh, no single non-interactive entrypoint of any kind.

ig-account-create's canonical location is `~/.agents/skills/ig-account-create/` (symlinked into `~/.claude/skills/` and `~/.openclaw/skills/`), entirely OUTSIDE `~/anicca/skills/` — the registry's own dir root and the loop's hardcoded `$ANICCA_HOME/skills/<slot>/run.sh` base (confirmed ANICCA_HOME=/Users/anicca/.anicca per the spec's own Ground Truth section). Even if a run.sh existed inside the ig-account-create dir, it would not be found unless physically placed at `$ANICCA_HOME/skills/ig-account-create/run.sh`.

ig-account-create's own SKILL.md ('Proven flow — NO-HUMAN, end to end') documents an inherently agent-judgment-driven procedure, not a deterministic script: step 3 says 'pick username until the red "使用できません" clears'; step 1 says 'Autocomplete corrupts the email field ... always native-set it last + re-verify'; the DOB step requires picking 'the VISIBLE listbox among several'; step 5 requires reading Gmail via `gog gmail search ... in:anywhere` (OTP sometimes lands in SPAM) and waiting through a 5-10s spinner. This matches project memory `feedback_warmup_two_layer_agentic_not_brittle_selectors` ('agent looks at screenshots + decides — thin script + agentic judgment, NOT brittle DOM selectors') — i.e. this skill is explicitly NOT meant to be a deterministic fire-and-forget script.

`runSkill()` in `run-skill.mjs:21-70` spawns the entrypoint as a non-interactive child process (`stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']`), waits for exit or a fixed `SKILL_TIMEOUT_S` (default 120s), and returns one combined stdout+stderr blob — there is no mechanism for the model to see intermediate state (screenshots, error messages) and adapt mid-execution, which is exactly what the Proven flow's steps require.
why_it_matters: REQ-102(a) claims the fix is simply 'add a registry entry (entrypoint pointing at a real, invocable script)' and REQ-102's closing sentence treats a real wake of 'EITHER loop' as an equally viable verification path. Neither is true: (1) the registry `entrypoint` field is cosmetic to the actual invocation code, so setting it to anything does not change what `resolveSkillPath()` actually calls; (2) no non-interactive script implementing ig-account-create's flow exists, and writing one would require substantial NEW code that reimplements the agent-judgment steps as brittle deterministic logic — directly contradicting REQ-102's own claim of 'reuses it verbatim ... no new signup code' and the project's own anti-brittle-automation principle. As written, an implementer following REQ-102(a) literally would either (a) add a registry entry that never actually gets exercised correctly by run_skill (silent no-op or crash on first use), or (b) end up writing an entirely new brittle automation script under time pressure, which is precisely the kind of low-quality shortcut this project's own rules (HARD RULE #0, feedback_build_agents_not_hardcode_regex) forbid.
distinguish_from_working_half: REQ-102(b) — updating clip-cli.sh's STARTUP prompt for claude-p — is mechanically sound and should be kept: claude-p is spawned via `clip-cli.sh:33` as a REAL `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions -- "$STARTUP"` process, i.e. an actual Claude Code CLI session with full native Skill/Bash/Read tool access. It can genuinely `Read` ig-account-create's SKILL.md and drive the cdp.py steps itself with full judgment, exactly as any Claude Code session (including this reviewing session) already can. This path requires NO new code and NO registry change — claude-p doesn't need registry.json or run_skill to use a Claude Code skill at all.
recommendation: Drop REQ-102(a)'s registry/genesis-loop half as unachievable without materially more design work (either a genuinely different invocation mechanism the loop doesn't have today — e.g. a way for run_skill to spawn a nested `claude -p` session against the SKILL.md, analogous to how brain.mjs/inference.mjs already spawn `claude -p` for the loop's OWN decision-making — or accept that ig-account-create only becomes genesis-loop-invokable once such a mechanism is built as a SEPARATE feature). Rescope REQ-102 to ONLY the claude-p path (REQ-102(b)), which is real, precedented, and requires zero new invocation machinery.
